title: Quaso
blurb: Quaso is croissant, run through the same brainrot pronunciation engine that turned sigma and aura into adjectives. It arrived on a wave of TikToks in which the word is delivered with total, entirely unearned reverence for a pastry. It stuck for the reason these things always stick: saying it correctly is impossible and saying it wrong is funnier. There is no deeper layer here and no origin story worth telling. There is only quaso, and there is only ever going to be quaso.
